items.title: Cisco (CSCO) Unveils Quantum Networking Push With New Distributed Systems Collaboration
items.summary: Cisco Systems (NasdaqGS:CSCO) announced a collaboration with quantum technology firm Infleqtion to advance distributed quantum networking architectures. The partners plan to work on quantum memory to optical transduction and networked quantum devices for long distance connectivity. Cisco highlighted a prototype Universal Quantum Switch as part of its push to connect, operate, and scale quantum systems. items.title: Has Arista Networks Stock Quietly Become A Different Bet?
